metrics.window_convention: WP-10r uses a distinct final-local-data-year OOS window from 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. No separate IS metric convention is introduced; in_sample.sharpe records the same actual window Sharpe for schema continuity.

data_provenance.source_data_notes: OL-0012 is derived from REP-0012. REP-0012 used a final-local-data-year evaluation subwindow that overlaps the prior local data snapshot because no later local data existed in repo truth and WP-10r performed no data fetch.

notes: WP-10s derives OL-0012 from REP-0012 for H-004 / research_oos / post_wp_5b / d2_006_gates. The gross_pnl <= 0 value is preserved from REP-0012. WP-10s performs no D2 cost-drag pass/fail reconciliation; any cost-drag comparison handling belongs to a later WP-10t REC package if Main 3.0 authorizes it. No REC-5 satisfaction is claimed, and this OL carries no policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, or protected-path authority.
